problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 37 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 67 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 37 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 41 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 60 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 48 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 36 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 57 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 46 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 47 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 37 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 52 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 62 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 34 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 68 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 22: size 37 cubic feet
* Package 23: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 24: size 54 cubic feet
* Package 25: size 60 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Each package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
